note: The curated add-ons the in-game Add-ons page offers (server/addons.py; docs/ADDONS.md). Listed with their authors' agreement. Only these repos can be installed from it; each add-on is downloaded from its author's own GitHub releases on the player's machine; nothing of theirs is copied here.

addons.name: Worldwide Trucking Career: Dangerous Contracts
addons.author: MadMerick01
addons.summary: A freight career on the real map: job boards in 178,000 real towns, a garage, trailers, fuel, punctures and dangerous high-paid roads.
addons.licence: Source available, not open source: free to download and play; re-uploading or sharing changed copies is not allowed.

addons.name: BeamNG.Earth Live GPS
addons.author: Leopri2008
addons.summary: Your Android phone's GPS follows your car, so Google Maps or Waze track your drive; plus a live map with search, navigation and fuel prices in any browser, a drive recorder and a fog-of-the-world map.
addons.licence: All rights reserved: free for personal use; no redistribution.
addons.note: A program that runs beside the game. Its live map is served on your Wi-Fi (port 47700) without a login, so other devices and web pages can read your car's position and trips while it runs. It looks up the street you're on with OpenStreetMap's Nominatim as you drive (turn off with its --no-places option). The Android app needs "Select mock location app" in the phone's developer options.
